an4.24:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sākete viharati Kāḷakārāme.
an4.24:2.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave sadevakassa lokassa . . . sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tam ahaṃ jānāmi.
an4.24:3.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave sadevakassa lokassa . . . pajāya devamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ . . . manasā tam ahaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ
an4.24:3.2: taṃ Tathāgatassa viditaṃ tam Tathāgato na upaṭṭhāsi.
an4.24:4.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave sadevakassa lokassa . . . pajāya devamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ . . . manasā tam ahaṃ jānāmī ti vadeyyaṃ taṃ mama assa musā
an4.24:5.1: tam ahaṃ jānāmi ca na ca jānāmīti vadeyyaṃ, taṃ p' assa tādisam eva,
an4.24:6.1: tam ahaṃ n' eva jānāmi na na jānāmīti vadeyyaṃ taṃ mama assa kali.
an4.24:7.1: Iti kho bhikkhave Tathāgato daṭṭhā daṭṭhabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na maññati adiṭṭhaṃ na maññati daṭṭhabbaṃ na maññati daṭṭhāraṃ na maññati,
an4.24:7.2: sutvā sotabbaṃ sutaṃ na maññati asutaṃ na maññati sotabbaṃ na maññati sotāraṃ na maññati,
an4.24:7.3: mutvā motabbaṃ mutam na maññati amutaṃ na maññati motabbaṃ na maññati motāraṃ na maññati,
an4.24:7.4: viññātvā viññātabbaṃ viññātaṃ na maññati aviññātaṃ na maññati viññātabbaṃ na maññati viññātāraṃ na maññati.
an4.24:7.5: Iti kho bhikkhave Tathāgato diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabbesu dhammesu tādi se yeva tādi
an4.24:7.6: tamhā ca pana tādi tamhā añño tādi uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā n' atthīti vadāmīti.
an4.24:8.1: Yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ mutaṃ vā
an4.24:8.4: saccaṃ musaṃ vā pi paraṃ daheyyaṃ
an4.24:9.4: ajjhositaṃ n' atthi Tathāgatānan ti. 25. 1. Na-
